description: This file defines the Polymer.IronMenuBehavior, a JavaScript behavior for accessible menu interactions in Polymer-based web components. It includes properties, event listeners, key bindings, and methods for managing focus, selection, and ARIA attributes of menu items.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects or toggles selection of a menu item based on the given value.

methods.name: _resetTabindices
methods.description: Resets tabindex attributes among menu items based on current selection for accessibility.

methods.name: _updateMultiselectable
methods.description: Sets or removes aria-multiselectable attribute based on the multi property.

methods.name: _focusWithKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Focuses an item whose title starts with the pressed key.

methods.name: _focusPrevious
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous item in the menu.

methods.name: _focusNext
methods.description: Moves focus to the next item in the menu.

methods.name: _applySelection
methods.description: Updates selection status and ARIA attributes for a menu item.

methods.name: _focusedItemChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the focusedItem property, updating tabindex and focus.

methods.name: _onIronItemsChanged
methods.description: Responds to DOM mutation events within the menu items.

methods.name: _onShiftTabDown
methods.description: Handles shift+tab key to manage focus traversal.

methods.name: _onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus events on the menu, focusing the selected or first item.

methods.name: _onUpKey
methods.description: Handles up arrow key to move focus upward.

methods.name: _onDownKey
methods.description: Handles down arrow key to move focus downward.

methods.name: _onEscKey
methods.description: Handles escape key to blur the focused item.

methods.name: _onKeydown
methods.description: Handles general keydown events for navigation and character-based focus.
